notes.title: 'The Ghost Ship' survival mode and 'Jolly Roger' casual mode added!
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy there Sea Rats![/h2]

It’s been quite some time since our last post but we’re super excited to launch a big content update today just in time to celebrate the [b]Steam Spring sale![/b]

This new content drop includes two brand-new game modes, balance changes to the in-game economy system, enhanced enemy and boss behaviour patterns, improved UI and map quality of life, two additional VO languages, and minor bug and achievement fixes! There’s a lot to cover, so read on for a breakdown of what's included. 

NOTE: This update is currently live on all versions EXCEPT for Nintendo Switch! We expect the Switch version to be updated in the next week or so, thanks for your patience!

[h3]New gameplay mode: ‘Jolly Roger’ (casual) mode[/h3]

The first of the two new game modes has been designed to address player feedback relating to the game’s difficulty and cater to a more casual play experience. The ‘Jolly Roger’ mode can be selected when you begin a new story campaign OR any time you change character when visiting Wu Yun during a campaign. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/91bfcf6519560f8af05f83a8656f985897d05824.png[/img]

This mode makes the following significant changes to the core gameplay:   
[list]
[*] Contact damage has been removed so you will only receive damage from enemies when they attack you. To complement this, most enemies no longer block your movement and can be passed through.
[*] Enemies only respawn in rooms if you interact with Wu Yun. This means that you can explore the environment more freely, and can no longer farm enemies by immediately re-entering cleared rooms. 
[*] You can now warp to unlocked ancestral doors from anywhere on the map and are therefore no longer required to backtrack to specific rooms.
[*] All enemies have reduced health.
[*] Player characters inflict more damage. 
[/list]
[h3]New gameplay mode: ‘The Ghost Ship’ (wave survival) mode[/h3]

On the flip side, the second game mode introduces a much more challenging experience in the form of an arcade-style wave survival mode that should appeal to players who love classic beat ‘em ups and racing against the clock! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/b2d252259424b53094dd5a62d322ae5de1beb809.gif[/img]

‘The Ghost Ship’ mode can be selected directly from the main menu and features: 
[list]
[*] 1-4 players must fight to clear 10 waves, with each wave consisting of a wide variety of enemies and bosses from the main story. Special abilities such as double jump and air dash are unlocked by default and will be essential for avoiding taking damage within such a confined space.   
[*] Once a wave has been cleared, pick between 3 different stat buffs or powerful items to increase your chances of survival. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/ed5d4577aa87465b01d939578368d95f61a3dc5b.png[/img]

[*] After certain ‘milestone’ waves you’ll also unlock additional bonuses in the form of new ‘inner element’ magical abilities and magic slots. But be warned, however, if all players are defeated progress will be lost!  
[*] Your fastest clear times will be logged after each wave so you can challenge yourself to smash your existing records!
[/list]
If the challenge proves too much you can also play ‘The Ghost Ship’ using the ‘Jolly Roger Mode settings.

[h3]Enemy bestiary[/h3]

We received a lot of requests for an enemy bestiary to be added to help complete ‘The Fighter’ achievement which requires you to defeat one of each enemy. A bestiary can now be accessed via the inventory menu once you have obtained the Explorer Goggles by defeating Rama Cinnamon and Banana and keeps a running tally of every enemy that you have defeated so far in your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/065ae9c77c817a623f9a9aebb2e7d08ee788424a.png[/img]

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]

In response to community feedback we’ve made the following balance changes:
[list]
[*] Gold and spiritual energy economies have been rebalanced.
[*] Enemies core stats have been rebalanced.
[*] All bosses have had their behavior patterns and animations adjusted to create more engaging boss fights. It is now much clearer which attack they will make and there is more time for you to react.
[/list]
[h3]UI and map changes[/h3]

We made some small changes to the UI and map:
[list]
[*] Tweaks to the UI and map background changes
[*] A new gate room has been added close to where you encounter Dolores. 
[/list]
[h3]Additional voiceover languages[/h3]

Alongside the full English VO, we have added Catalan and Spanish voice acting reflecting our heritage as a Barcelona-based studio! 

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

Finally, we have squashed the following bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Cocoon debuff.
[*] Fixed Gunner VFX not ending properly.
[*] Fixed missing map icons. 
[*] Fixed audio issues when quickly changing scenes. 
[*] Fixed the initial cutscene not working on Steam Deck. 
[*] Fixed visual bug when a box falls above a player. 
[*] Fixed teleportation bug when other players change scenes. 
[*] Fixed VFX not disappearing after scene change. 
[*] Fixed incorrect dialogues in certain situations. 
[*] Adjusted the volume of some sound effects. 
[*] Fixed Necromancer not reappearing in some cases.
[*] Fixed Morrigan being able to take damage while invulnerable. 
[*] Improved legibility of some notification text.
[*] Fixed spirit counter showing incorrect numbers upon first appearance. 
[*] Fixed minimap does not reappear after the boss fights in some cases. 
[*] Fixed hitbox for Gunner enemy. 
[*] Fixed projectiles do not work when enemies are electrocuted. 
[*] Fixed movement during cutscenes. 
[*] Fixed audio issues when blocking Specter. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Freddy’s mini spiders didn’t appear. 
[*] Adjusted font size across all UI elements.
[*] Fixed enemies sometimes do not deal damage.
[*] Fixed InkTopus death animation. 
[*] Fixed issues with effects UI. 
[*] Fixed Skull Thrower player detection. 
[*] Fixed bug when skipping Granny Malone’s dialogue. 
[*] Fixed several shader issues. 
[*] Fixed some debuffs not hiding in the UI. 
[*] Fixed Bussa block. 
[*] Fixed issue when dashing after a dash attack. 
[*] Fixed Morrigan’s VFX not disappearing in some cases.
[*] Fixed the issue where Leprechaun didn’t reappear after failing the minigame.
[*] Fixed the hitbox of Banana Tucan not flipping correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug when disconnecting the controller in a room with a different FOV. 
[*] Fixed issue with controller vibration not stopping. 
[*] Fixed The Fighter trophy unlocks.
[*] Fixed delay when opening the inventory on some platforms. 
[*] Fixed bug when opening the map while running.
[/list]
Thank you all for your continued support, we really hope you’ll enjoy the new content and improvements we have made. The Steam Spring sale runs from [b]13th - 20th March[/b] and we’ll be running a [u][b]massive 65% discount[/b][/u] on Curse of the Sea Rats for the duration of the event, so now is the perfect time to grab some mates and jump in 🙂

Petoons Studio & PQube

notes.title: Free 'The Ghost Ship' survival mode update coming soon!
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome back Sea Rats![/h3]

We’re excited to share with you our upcoming plans for the [b]upcoming 1.4.0 patch[/b] as well as reveal a FREE content drop which adds an entirely [b]new gameplay mode![/b]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/1bd5a1951421c1f895c5243064d1293cd0ce5dbd.png[/img]

Thank you all for the love and support so far with [i][b]Curse of the Sea Rats[/b][/i], your feedback has helped us implement three waves of updates so far including:
[list]
[*] [b]1.0.2:[/b] Rebalanced Character Skills and Robert Garfield’s Store Prices for a smoother and fairer experience along with several bug fixes
[*] [b]1.1.2:[/b] More bug fixes and changes to the late-game progression and final sequence to make the experience feel less grind-y.
[*] [b]1.3.7:[/b] Major improvements to the combat system including animation cancelling, improved hitbox detection, more dynamic and responsive platforming, disabled pitfall deaths, improved Map UI, and so many more quality-of-life changes!
[/list]
The improvements won’t stop there, as mentioned we are now working towards the next big patch, 1.4.0. This update will add an [b]enemy log menu[/b] to showcase which enemies (and how many of them) the player has defeated, [b]improvements to the player inventory UI[/b], and additional changes to [b]boss balancing.[/b] 1.4.0 is scheduled to go live later this Summer.

This brings us to an exciting announcement, we’re currently putting the finishing touches on a [b]Major Free Content Update![/b] [i][b]“The Ghost Ship” [/b][/i]adds a new [b]Survival Mode[/b] that tasks players with defeating increasingly more challenging waves of enemies and bosses one after another!

If the player(s) can clear a wave they will receive a reward in the form of a usable item, attack or defence buff before progressing onto the next wave. After certain ‘milestone’ waves player characters will also unlock additional bonuses in the form of new ‘inner element’ magical abilities and skills. But be warned however, if all players are defeated progress will be lost! 

When playing through [i][b]The Ghost Ship[/b][/i] your fastest clear times will be logged after each wave so you can challenge yourself to smash your existing records!  

How far will you progress against such terrifying odds? [i][b]The Ghost Ship[/b][/i] update is planned for Fall 2023.

Finally, if you’re enjoying Curse of the Sea Rats please consider leaving a positive review? We’re working hard to respond to as much player feedback as possible and add exciting new content to make the experience the very best it can be. 

Until next time!

Petoons Studio

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.3.7
notes.content:
[b]Combat System[/b]
[list]
[*] General improvements to the combat in order to make it more fast-paced and dynamic:
[*] Attacks are now cancelable with the jump and parry actions.
[*] Hurt animations have been shortened.
[*] Hitboxes when sliding have been improved.
[*] Character Control
[*] General
[*] Rebalanced the skill tree for all four characters.
[*] All the attacks' ranges have been increased to better adjust the slashes to their hitboxes.
[/list]

[b]David Douglas[/b]
[list]
[*] Run Attack's momentum has been reduced and its speed has been increased.
[*] Down Air Attack’s boost has been increased and its preparation speed has been increased.
[*] Parry animation has been reduced and recovers faster.
[*] Improvements to the Fireball attack.
[*] Akane Yamakawa
[*] Faster recovery after parrying.
[*] Changed the hits per second of the Water Shield attack.
[/list]

[b]Bussa[/b]
[list]
[*] Run Attack's momentum has been reduced and its speed has been increased.
[*] Knockdown animation has been shortened.
[*] Improved Dash hitbox activation.
[*] Multiple tweaks to the Down Attack.
[/list]

[b]Buffalo Calf[/b]
[list]
[*] Knockdown animation has been shortened.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Disabled death upon pitfall; now the player teleports to a connected room.
[*] Added Dolores in a new room between the Flora and Long Fuse Jones boss fights (with a save point and teleport), to allow the player to purchase items and further unlock the skill tree.
[*] Now the Backtrack stones can be removed by interacting with them.
[*] Changed the spikes' placement, size, and damage caused.
[*] Improved Major Mallory’s tutorial with clearer visual guidance.
[*] Reduced amount of enemies in Fodla’s Bog.
[/list]

[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] Added map legend.
[*] Added custom markers functions to the map.
[*] Added map marker that shows the buried treasures' locations.
[*] Added map marker that shows the NPCs’ positions.
[*] Added XP counter on the status UI.
[*] Updated inventory item order.
[*] Implemented defined order for the Treasure Bag’s items.
[*] Added combo details in the Transmutation item description.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixing[/b]
[list]
[*] Changing the direction on the D-Pad works correctly.
[*] Cutscenes don’t display graphical corruption.
[*] All chest icons on the map update properly after opening them.
[*] Poison status and buffs don’t persist after death.
[*] Enabling or disabling the minimap saves correctly.
[*] Treasure icons show properly when the meanwhile scenes end.
[*] Sam doesn’t disappear when reloading.
[*] Spirit drops don’t follow the player if collected while resurrecting with the resurrection ring.
[*] SFX doesn’t persist after the Long Fuse Jones fight.
[*] All dialogues are properly skippable.
[*] Dying on a room transition doesn’t cause the game to crash.
[*] Player always properly dies and respawns when falling into a water pit.
[*] Bussa’s skill tree descriptions have all the correct values.
[*] Correct SFX volume when collecting the XP orbs dropped when dying.
[*] Quitting the telescope on the Lighthouse is more intuitive.
[*] Resurrecting the Necromancer without changing to a different room works correctly.
[*] Platforms appear correctly in the Necromancer boss fight.
[*] Enemies don’t disappear briefly upon being hit.
[*] Multiple enemies' AI bugs have been corrected.
[*] Treasure items don’t appear in the general inventory after using the shortcuts feature.
[*] No need to press Join when selecting a character in single mode.
[*] Addressed some localization issues.
[*] Enemies' alpha values in Tuatha de Danann Temple are now correct.
[*] Improved performance on the credits scene.
[*] Added missing consumable items in Robert’s stores 2 & 3.
[*] All SFX change volume according to the master mixer’s value.
[*] Animated slide bar added to the bosses' HP HUD.
[*] Fixed some level design issues.
[*] Corrected and improved multiple environment art issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Character Spotlight: Akane Yamakawa
notes.content:
Today we’ll be wrapping up our series of [b]character spotlights[/b] by introducing [b]Akane Yamakawa[/b], the final member of the cursed crew who’ll be joining [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3189122178171113907][b]David Douglas[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/4766508662079354328]Buffalo Calf[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1453900/view/3323106153058340565][b]Bussa[/b][/url] on their quest to save the Admiral’s son and regain their freedom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/58cbcb2e43be4e908916ed80271a77dc4614c682.png[/img]

Akane Yamakawa is a [b]Japanese Onna-bugeisha[/b], a trained warrior of the Shogun who was captured whilst on a secret mission in America. Although very little is known about her mysterious past, her skill at wielding her [b]deadly naginata[/b] is without question.  

[h3]Sting Like a Bee[/h3]

Of all of the crew, Akane Yamakawa possesses the close combat [b]weapon with the longest reach[/b] and as such, excels at [b]mid to long range combat[/b]. Her naginata can land hits from a far greater distance than David Douglas’s cutlass, and is invaluable at keeping enemies at bay before they can get close enough to strike. 

As a warrior of the Shogun, she has complete mastery over her weapon and is capable of many impressive and [b]acrobatic feats[/b]. Attacking while jumping high in the air allows her to sweep her blade around or [b]bring it straight down[/b] on the enemy from above. Her combination attack demonstrates her prowess with [b]two fast sweeping strikes followed by a flurry of precise stabs[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/7cbcdcbd4b97aaa6c64d635bf4bd652ead4641a0.gif[/img]

If she attacks while rushing towards an opponent, Akane will perform a slight running leap, [b]thrusting her naginata forward for maximum reach[/b].

[h3]Be Like Water[/h3]

As the most poised and graceful of the crew, Akane Yamakawa naturally gained a special [b]affinity for water[/b] when imbued with the magics of the amulet. One of her first abilities, [b]Water Charge[/b], surrounds Akane in water as she lunges forward, dealing damage to any enemy caught in her path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/4f8fedb91147c95d3cab482d195af5d488ee4607.gif[/img]

Persistent enemies may manage to charge past Akane’s whirling naginata, and in these instances, she can use her [b]Water Shield[/b]. This ability envelops her in a pool of water that deals damage to anyone unfortunate enough to get too close. Water Shield can be improved using the [b]Ice Breaker[/b] upgrade that reduces incoming damage even further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/1b2f92c2fde3a3081c6c9d165c7e43fb25f83fbe.jpg[/img]

For prolonged battles and long journeys into unknown territory, the [b]Water Fall[/b] ability will allow Akane to passively regenerate her energy. 

And finally, with her ultimate art, [b]Tsunami[/b], she can call forth a terrifying tidal wave to come crashing down around her that deals magical damage to all enemies. 

That concludes our look at the cutthroat crew of Curse of the Sea Rats! Who will you be choosing?

Join our [b]Discord[/b] and let us know who you'll be choosing in your fight against the dreaded [b]Captain Flora Burn.[/b]

[url=https://discord.com/channels/707335419167113217/956597128090750996][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/7546763a75a38c09ff4c709bc05e0f68fa296629.png[/img][/url]

Until next time!

notes.title: Welcome Back to the Original Rat Pack
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy Rats, Rebels, and Renegades![/h2]

It's been some time since our last post but we're back with some big news! Firstly, we wanted to thank our community for their patience and to assure you that we have planned a regular series of developer updates that we'll be pushing out every few weeks from now until launch later this year. 

You can expect more information on dates and milestones, key game features as well as progress updates and other fun behind the scenes content!

[h3]Kickstarter Backer Demo[/h3]

A few weeks back we gave our loyal Kickstarter backers whose pledge level included 'beta access' a first exclusive look at the [b][i]Curse of the Sea Rats[/i][/b] demo. We can't thank our backers enough for supporting the project from such an early stage and hope that everyone is enjoying their time exploring the world of [b][i]Curse of the Sea Rats[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/77cba5f3adbeb3ea42cac3c2ef60ccb9cb5feb19.jpg[/img]

[h3]Backer Feedback Changes[/h3]

An important aspect of this backer demo has been gathering player feedback, and we've had a really positive response so far! We have implemented a number of key fixes in response to backer's comments and suggestions and [b]today[/b] we are releasing an updated version of the demo for backers to play. 

The change list is as follows:  

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with incompatible controllers. 
[*] Bussa blocking modified to be faster.  
[*] Fixed camera in Blacksmith intro.  
[*] Now settings presets work.  
[*] Visual improvements for the skill trees.  
[*] Fixed some chests that kept appearing in the minimap.  
[*] Other minor bug fixes. 
[/list]
To see these new changes please restart Steam and remember, this demo is only available on Steam and Windows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/5562508534a44bfa1e47d613fe5ef8c8ca47d27b.png[/img]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

As you know, the demo is a work-in-progress preview of the game, and content is therefore subject to change. One area the team are currently working on improving is the [b]whole cinematic system[/b] so that the player can decide when text opens. Due to the technical complexity of this particular issue, we are sorry to say that this will [b]not[/b] be implemented in the demo, but rest assured it will make its way into the finished game!  

Elsewhere, one of the main focuses has been balancing the game to make it [b]challenging, yet fair and enjoyable.[/b] All of the crew are working hard to improve the gameplay experience for the final version. The development of the game continues as planned and we expect to release the game in [b]2022[/b], all being well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/3d4a7314bc76601e32c73469535798ad5763559f.png[/img]

[h3]How to Submit Feedback[/h3]

[b][i]The Curse of the Sea Rats[/i][/b] crew is always grateful for feedback. If you’ve played the demo and would like to share your comments and suggestions, please feel free to fill out this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflmy_ZVNQnzbW15FC7-zY2T3Gw84W3oqXnco-UOnh9BkU4vw/viewform]feedback form[/url]. 

Alternatively, our community in [b]Discord[/b] is growing and you can join us in the specific demo channel only for backers and connect with all the pirates supporting the project. 

[url=https://discord.com/channels/707335419167113217/956597128090750996][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/7546763a75a38c09ff4c709bc05e0f68fa296629.png[/img][/url]

Remember that if your pledge level allows, you will have free access to this beta version of the game until [b]22nd April 2022[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/ecf61c00bce2325956e616681e2f4870cdec6b41.png[/img]

[h3][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Content Creation & Embargo[/h3]

We’ve received a lot of questions about posting on social media, sharing footage and screenshots of the beta, and just have a few rules concerning this: 

[olist]
[*] There is an embargo on content sharing in effect until [b]22nd April 2022[/b]. Please do not talk about the game, share any gameplay capture, videos or screenshots before that date. 
[*] For any content that you do create, please include the disclaimer “[i]This content was captured from an early preview build of the game and is, therefore, subject to change[/i].” 
[/olist]
If any content is posted before the embargo date, we will request that it be taken down (sorry!). 

Enjoy the new version of the demo and please, report all the bugs you can find!  

Thank you very much, pirates! We'll be back with another update soon!

Petoons Studio

notes.title: Development update – Charting a new course 🗺️
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ahoy there! 🏴‍☠️[/b][/h3]
How are ye, mateys?

Many of you have been asking us for a new update, so here we are to fulfill your wishes (as always)! We are now ready to share important news about the release, so make sure to read until the end 😉

During the last couple of months we’ve been heavily focused on developing the game, but not to worry – we will soon be back online posting more content. Today, we’d like you to take a first look at some new material we’ve been working on!

[h2]New bosses and animations 🖌️[/h2]
Our concept artists have put a tremendous amount of work designing new bosses, NPCs, environments, and much more. Although this is just a sneak peek of their recent work, here are a couple of things we couldn’t wait to share:

A group of mysterious caged pirates that will ask for your help…

⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/aa35215ee808742414a23a3f52955e0e025d050e.png[/img]

…and a fearsome villain you will have to face in your adventure!

⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/ddbfc3cf4e4cdfd88d39272446730f8a466a377f.png[/img]

Our animators are also pouring all their talent bringing to life all these new characters coming from the art team. And they keep polishing animations of the well-known playable characters to make their moves completely flawless:

[h2]Preparing rewards 🎁[/h2]

Take a look at some (work in progress) pages of the Curse of the Sea Rats Artbook, one of the many rewards that will end up in the hands of some lucky pi-rats!

⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39297607/226f910380c84814ab1ce9e68bf77f52d9402231.png[/img]


[h2]New key dates 📅[/h2]
We love sharing new material, but more importantly, we’d like to update you on the game’s release. For well-known reasons, this last year has been particularly difficult for all of us, and as any other studio we’ve had to face our challenges. However, nothing and no one will sink our ship!

After having carefully analyzed the project’s development stage, we’ve recently defined with our publisher PQube an updated production plan.

Many of you were expecting the Beta access to take place this summer; unfortunately, we will have to push it a few months and will take place later this year.

In regards to the game release, we have agreed with PQube that, given the current circumstances, it is best to postpone the launch to early 2022.

We will confirm specific dates for the two the moment they are defined.

This extra time will help us bring you a much better experience, so we kindly ask you to be patient for a little longer. There’s a lot of hype around this game and we don’t want to under-deliver. This news is certainly frustrating for everyone (us, too!), but we wouldn’t do it if we weren’t sure it is indeed the best decision for the project. We aim to be excellent video game crafters, and hopefully, all of you pirates on board will share our vision for Curse of the Sea Rats.

[u][h3]Stay tuned for more info on Curse of the Sea Rats 📢[/h3][/u]
We will soon be back online posting regular content of our pi-RATS and further updates on Curse of the Sea Rats! Make sure to join us on Discord!
